BREAKING: Ex-IAF Officer Takes Ram Mandir Helm Amid Congress Row Over Appointment
articles.description: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has initiated a major administrative restructuring following its inaugural strategy meeting with newly appointed Chief Executive Officer, retired Air Marshal Jitendra Mishra. General Secretary Govind Dev Giri escorted Mishra through the temple complex and workshops to formulate stringent standard operating procedures and overhaul governance, stressing that restoring public confidence remains the trust’s foremost priority after recent donation theft concerns. Mishra stated he will formally assume charge after concluding operational orientations over the coming days to master daily protocols. However, the military veteran's appointment has triggered a fierce national political confrontation. Senior Congress leader Rashid Alvi stirred severe controversy by questioning whether the appointment was intended to conceal classified facts regarding "Operation Sindoor," demanding to know why post-retirement military officials were receiving prime institutional assignments. While the Congress leadership swiftly distanced itself by characterizing Alvi’s contentious remarks as personal opinions rather than party policy, the Bharatiya Janata Party launched an aggressive counter-offensive. BJP leaders accused the opposition of habitually disparaging Sanatan Dharma and casting unverified aspersions on the armed forces, turning the routine temple administrative induction into a high-stakes partisan war of words.
